# Zeroback

> Open-source real-time backend for Cloudflare. Type-safe functions, reactive queries, your infrastructure.

Zeroback is an open-source Convex-compatible backend that runs on Cloudflare Workers + Durable Objects + SQLite. It provides real-time queries, transactional mutations, type-safe codegen, and framework bindings for React and Solid.js.

## Documentation

- [Getting Started](https://zeroback.dev/getting-started/): Set up Zeroback in under 5 minutes
- [Quickstart: React](https://zeroback.dev/quickstart-react/): Build a real-time React app from scratch
- [Schema](https://zeroback.dev/schema/): Define tables, validators, indexes, and search indexes
- [Functions](https://zeroback.dev/functions/): Write queries, mutations, actions, HTTP routes, and cron jobs
- [Database](https://zeroback.dev/database/): Query and mutate data with filters, pagination, and full-text search
- [Client](https://zeroback.dev/client/): WebSocket client with auto-reconnect, optimistic updates, and persistence
- [React](https://zeroback.dev/react/): React hooks for real-time queries and mutations
- [Solid.js](https://zeroback.dev/solid/): Solid.js primitives for real-time queries and mutations
- [Authentication](https://zeroback.dev/authentication/): Bring your own auth
- [Scheduling](https://zeroback.dev/scheduling/): One-off scheduled functions and recurring cron jobs
- [File Storage](https://zeroback.dev/storage/): Upload and serve files using Cloudflare R2
- [CLI](https://zeroback.dev/cli/): init, dev, deploy, codegen, reset, run
- [How It Works](https://zeroback.dev/how-it-works/): Architecture, subscriptions, OCC, and codegen internals
- [Deployment](https://zeroback.dev/deployment/): Deploy to Cloudflare Workers
